title: Flo Automatic Shutoff Event Summary
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flo:event event=auto_shutoff
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as auto_shutoffs by home _time
| where auto_shutoffs>0
| sort - auto_shutoffs
description: Uses Flo shutoff events telemetry to monitor automatic shutoffs by month in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for whether leak protection is frequently intervening, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Flo shutoff events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly chart of Flo automatic shutoffs.
grandmaExplanation: It lists automatic shutoffs by month so you can spot whether leak protection is frequently intervening before it becomes annoying.
